filed: 2026-11-04, before the code ran; never edited after the run
question: E85 Amendment 2. Gamma rounds V to bf16 before its readout (qwen_vpd.py readout, line 249). Does that hide a placement from g?
claim: Computing the readout in fp32 moves g on the rarely-on placement no more than it moves g on the unchanged decomposition: rounding is not a limit.
null: Same as the claim. The alternative is g moving much more under fp32 on the moved V than on W0's.
rules_code: experiments/qwen_d1_teeth/rules_amend.py reading, floors_ok; run against a number on each factor, a zero floor, NaN and an f1 over f2 in tests/test_qwen_d1_teeth_amend.py before filing
names: g is the code's name: qwen_vpd.site_importance's output, clip(head(backbone) + readout, 0, 1), what m = g + (1 - g) s reads. The sum before the clip has no name in the code; called before_clip here. The rule reads g, since that is all the masks see; before_clip is reported beside it.
apparatus: One L40, debug QoS. The first 8 of the 128 web rows of 512 tokens. Target fp32, Gamma bf16, V fp32 on the host and a site at a time on the card (no U). No adversary, no masked forward.

arms.W0: weights W0, V W0's, as run
arms.W0 again: the same through qwen_vpd.importances, the code's whole path: the repeat floor f1, and the check that this read is that path
arms.W0 fp32: the same forward; h and the readout computed in fp32 from the fp32 V, so g's sum is fp32. Taps and backbone stay bf16: the rounding floor f2
arms.Rare: E85's Rare as run: weights W0 + dW, the half's V columns moved
arms.Rare fp32: the same forward as Rare, with the readout in fp32
arms.Held: the same forward as Rare, V held at W0's: activations alone. Identical to do-nothing's g
arms.Rand: E85's Rand at one times, as run

read: Mean |a - b| over every position and column, and the share of (position, column) pairs moving over 0.01, for g and before_clip, on the alive columns and on the rarely-on half's. Per site on the alive columns, per row pooled. Names in amend2.json summary: W0_level (g against 0, for scale), W0_repeat (f1), W0_fp32 (f2), Rare (A: Rare against W0), Rare_fp32 (b: Rare fp32 against Rare), Rare_move_fp32 (Rare fp32 against W0 fp32), Held (against W0), Rare_V_route (Rare against Held), Rand (against W0). Also KL(W0 || state) on the 8 rows for the fine-tune and for E85's Gaussian at 1, 30 and 100 times, the last two for Amendment 1.

rules.reading_reads: b, f1, f2 on g, the half's columns, pooled over sites and rows. floor = max(f1, f2)
rules.rounding is not a limit: question closed: b at or under 2 floor. A moved V's rounding is one realisation of what an unmoved V's is, so b and f2 should read alike; 2 leaves room for their row spread, read beside
rules.fp32 moves g much more: one fp32-V adver: b at or over 5 floor. Under the two-amendment rule that start is a new plan
rules.no call: between. Reported as read; does not open an amendment

edge_cases.zero floor: stopped first by floors_ok; as a rule b = 0 closes, b > 0 is the follow-up
edge_cases.on a factor: 2 floor closes, 5 floor is the follow-up

leans.reading: closes, medium. The review's reasoning: rounding adds noise about the size of dV to what Gamma sees, without erasing it, and g's clip hides most of it, since most g sit at 0
leans.Rare_over_Rand: Rare's g moves more than Rand's, high: u1 is aligned with the inputs (1440 input-weighted on 3.49 plain) and Rand is not
leans.Rand30_kl: kl_W0 at 30 times 0.01 to 2, wide. Square law between the scales (E75's search: 100 times the scale is about 10^4 times the KL)

expected.W0_repeat: 0, or a stop if over W0_fp32 (floors_ok)
expected.W0_fp32: above 0, a stop if 0; order 1e-5 to 1e-3, unmeasured
expected.Rare: unmeasured; the same order as W0_fp32 or above
expected.Held: most of Rare: the review expects the activation route to carry it
expected.active_share: 8 rows over W0_fineweb's file, 0.5 to 2, or a stop; the half's under the alive columns', or a stop
expected.FT_clean: KL(W0 || FT) on the 8 rows 0.01 to 0.2, or a stop; E79's 8 rows of 256 tokens read 0.040

fits_an_L40: Yes, by adding measured sizes: target 6.9 and Gamma bf16 17.1 GB (qwen_maps.read_rows docstring, and E85's 48.2 GB load with components 19.5 and dW 2.8), two sets of weights at 5.6 each (E85 Rand's 66.2 against W0's 60.5), 35.2 GB fixed; a row adds g 1.41 twice, site inputs ~0.8, logits ~0.3 three times. ~40 GB against 46. V and U stay off the card, unlike every E80 job. An assert stops a card under 44 GiB.

blind_to.g: The clip hides any move while g stays at 0; a pooled mean hides a few columns moving a lot, so the share over 0.01 and the per-site read are beside it. Reads one state on 8 rows; says nothing about the search or a smaller update, where dV sits further under a spacing.
blind_to.fp32: Only the readout route is fp32. Taps and backbone stay bf16, so a move through activations is still rounded in every arm; Gamma was trained in bf16 on a V that did not move.
blind_to.closed: It means a moved V rounds as an unmoved V does, not that g hears the placement well: Rare_move_fp32 against Rare is beside the rule for that.

control: W0 again through the code's own importances: reads 0 if this read is the code's path. W0 fp32: must differ from as run. The positive control for the metric is Rare against W0.
noise_floor: f1 and f2, in this job, on the same rows; per-row reads beside.
stops: floors_ok, active_share, half_is_rarer, FT_clean, card under 44 GiB, a dW sha256 miss; results/stopped_amend2.json then refuses a rerun
